title: Cohomology comparison for the open complement of finitely many points
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, let Cbar be a proper smooth connected curve over k [def-sc-curves], let S be a finite set of closed points of Cbar, let C := Cbar minus S, and let j:C \to Cbar be the open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For the etale sheaf G_m [def-sc-gm-torsor] on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], the natural map H^q(Cbar_et,j_*G_m) \to H^q(C_et,G_m) is an isomorphism for every q <= 2.
